description: Who this connection acts as (user or API key) and every company it may act for, with read or read + write access in each (a.k.a. whoami). Call it first when the user belongs to several companies or a call says access is denied; then pass `company` (id, @handle or exact name) to the other tools. No arguments. Returns: acting_as {type, name, email or prefix, app}, connection (api_key or oauth), all_companies, default_company and companies[] {id, name, handle, plan, plan_name, role, access, default}.
name: list_companies
title: Who am I / my companies
